lookups.evidenceParaphrase: The Japanese dictionary explicitly distinguishes native うじ as a respectful surname suffix, with an attested 1825 example, and explains that this suffix receded as on-reading し took the same role in modern times. The encyclopedia explicitly illustrates 山田氏 with suffix reading うじ.
lookups.extractionLimit: Digital Daijisen heading was present without extracted definition; the claim relies on the actually returned named dictionary/encyclopedia sections, not that empty heading. Other historical/etymological accounts on the aggregate page were not adopted.

inspectedHeadings: 扱: on/kun, meanings and linked word headings
lookups.evidenceParaphrase: The actual character entry lists キュウ/ソウ and あつかう/こく/しごく, with handling, undertaking and treating-as senses. Its word navigation explicitly shows 扱く こ-く.
The complete returned word definition describes stripping or rubbing something off through the hand or an implement, and gives rice stripping as its example.

inspectedHeadings: 乃: readings, numbered senses and word navigation
lookups.evidenceParaphrase: The character entry explicitly lists ダイ/ナイ and すなわち/なんじ/の. Its numbered senses give a connecting function, a second-person gloss and phonetic use for の. The word navigation explicitly identifies 乃ち すなわ-ち, 乃公 ダイコウ and 乃 なんじ.
lookups.extractionLimit: The dedicated 乃 なんじ word URL returned only copyright text. It supplies no additional definition evidence.

inspectedHeadings: 乃至 ナイシ, senses 1 and 2
lookups.evidenceParaphrase: The quantity-range sense includes quantities between the stated endpoints; the separate second sense is または/あるいは. The actual entry gives both quantity and category examples.

inspectedHeadings: 彗: on/kun, senses, radical image identifier and word navigation
lookups.evidenceParaphrase: The entry lists スイ/ケイ/エ and the broom gloss ほうき; word navigation gives 彗星 スイセイ and 彗 ほうき. The displayed radical image was downloaded and visually inspected: a slanted 彐-like lower form. Its filename 57c.png is not evidence that the site assigns classical radical 57.
The actual word entry defines a broom made from grass or bamboo for sweeping dust and rubbish and notes the alternative spelling 箒.

inspectedHeadings: 漱: readings, mouth-rinsing meaning, word navigation
lookups.evidenceParaphrase: The actual character entry lists ソウ and すすぐ/くちすすぐ/うがい. Word navigation explicitly displays 漱ぐ くちすす-ぐ and 漱ぐ すす-ぐ, establishing the written boundaries independently of the source's dot conventions.
lookups.extractionLimit: Both dedicated 漱ぐ word pages returned copyright text only. The boundary evidence is the actually inspected character-page linked headings, not unseen definitions.
